notes.title: 「Kirakira stars idol project set」Release!
notes.notes:
The 『Kirakira stars idol project set』 a set of three works (『Kirakira stars project Ai』, 『Kirakira stars project Nagisa』, and『Kirakira stars project Reika』), is now on sale.
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18362/Kirakira_stars_idol_project_set/

You can play the game at a discount by purchasing it all together in this set.
Also, we'll be participating in the Winter Sale coming up soon on Steam, so take that opportunity to play it!

Thank you very much for your continued support of "Sushi soft".

notes.title: 「Kirakira stars idol project Reika」Pre-trial version available!
notes.notes:
To coincide with the Game Festival Autumn 2020
「Kirakira stars idol project Reika」 is now available as an advance trial version!

You can play the first chapter of this game.
If you'd like, please play it at least once.
Also, we've added character voices, so enjoy the cute voices of each character!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1396050/Kirakira_stars_idol_project_Reika/

Added on 10/12
English translation has been added to the advance trial version!

*Please note that there is a possibility that the translation may change from the full version.

Thank you very much for your continued support of "Sushi soft".
